Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for assay CHEMBL3705858. Join assays, activities, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter to exact measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
